# Marco Antonio Rulfo Castro

Marco Antonio Rulfo Castro, also known as Marco Rulfo, is a web developer and SEO, GEO and UX specialist based in Naucalpan de Juárez, Estado de México, Mexico.

## Expertise

- Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Technical and ecommerce SEO
- UX and conversion optimization
- React and TypeScript development
- WordPress and Salesforce Commerce Cloud
- Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Google Search Console
- Semrush, artificial intelligence and automation

## Professional profile

Marco works at Diltex brands and has experience in ecommerce, web development, SEO, GEO, UX, analytics and artificial intelligence.
